scanfi.citation: Guindon L., Correia D.L.P., Manka F., Smiley B. 2026. SCANFI v2. NRCan CFS. https://doi.org/10.23687/07653869-f303-46c2-a04e-9ab479b73cbf

aggregation.method: exact 33x33 pixel block sums at 30 m; block centroid used for ecodistrict/province attribution

method.forest_mask: NFI landcover classes 5 (treed broadleaf), 6 (treed conifer), 7 (treed mixed).
method.species_layers: SCANFI v2 species layers are absolute crown closure (%), not relative composition.
method.crown_closure_area: sum(species_cc / 100) * pixel_area within the forest mask. Not forced to equal forest area.
method.allocated_area: Within each 990 m block, species area shares are normalised across the ten SCANFI species layers and multiplied by forest area. Blocks with zero species crown closure are assigned to UNSPECIFIED. Pixels with species sum > 100% are quarantined as QA_OVER100.
method.species_resolution: SCANFI resolves ten species/classes only. Broadleaf, white/red pine, and other conifer are composite or proxy targets and are flagged.
method.province_attribution: Block-centroid rasterisation of geoBoundaries CAN ADM1 (simplified, derived from Statistics Canada boundaries). Boundary blocks are assigned to one province; coastal simplification may shift a small number of blocks.
method.unit_gap_fill: Blocks whose centroid falls outside every ecodistrict or province polygon (mainly lakes, rivers, and coastlines) are assigned to the nearest unit. Filled forest area is reported in ecodistrict_attribution_qa.csv.

validation.note: NFI Table 4.0 is a national forest-land benchmark, not a province-level control. SCANFI treed classes include treed land outside the NFI forest-land definition and are expected to differ.

outputs.scanfi_class_crosswalk.csv: SCANFI class to RSYC species mapping
outputs.zero_area_units.csv: ecodistrict units with zero SCANFI forest area
outputs.ecodistrict_attribution_qa.csv: nearest-unit fill area for coastline/lake blocks

caveats: SCANFI is a prediction surface, not a census or a provincial inventory.
Species area is composition-weighted forest area, not a species-specific inventory volume.
White/red pine is split 50/50; broadleaf and other conifer are composite/proxy targets.
Province boundaries are simplified 1:10m-class polygons; use for attribution, not legal boundaries.
No MGM yield curves are joined in this product.
